_meta.note: Codex was unable to locate project files in CascadeProjects. Tasks generated from direct code review. Import into your task queue or process with Claude Code.

tasks.title: Singleton DB connection
tasks.issue: getDb() calls `new Database(DB_PATH)` on every request, and re-runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS every time. Wastes file handles and prevents WAL optimisations.
acceptance_criteria: getDb() returns same instance on repeated calls
WAL pragma is set exactly once
All existing tests still pass

tasks.title: Paginate GET /api/notes
tasks.issue: Line 44: `SELECT * FROM notes ORDER BY id DESC` returns every row with no LIMIT. Full table scan + full JSON serialization on every history load.
acceptance_criteria: GET returns max 50 rows by default
GET ?page=1 returns next 50
Response includes a `total` count field

tasks.title: Enforce raw_text size limit
tasks.issue: Line 9: No upper bound on raw_text length. A 50 MB payload would be passed into parseNote() which splits, maps, and iterates every line — blocking the Node.js event loop.
acceptance_criteria: POST with >50 000 chars returns 413
POST with exactly 50 000 chars returns 201
Error body is { error: string }

tasks.title: Validate Content-Type on POST
tasks.issue: If Content-Type is missing or wrong, Next.js skips JSON body parsing and req.body is undefined. The handler then silently returns 400 'raw_text is required' with no explanation.
acceptance_criteria: POST without Content-Type: application/json returns 415
POST with correct header still works

tasks.title: Add HTTP security headers
tasks.issue: No security headers set. Minor risk locally but a blocker before any deployment.
acceptance_criteria: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff present on all responses
X-Frame-Options: DENY present on all responses

tasks.title: Extract repository layer from API route
tasks.issue: The handler does HTTP parsing, calls parseNote(), executes SQL, and shapes the response — 4 responsibilities in one 58-line function. This is why api.test.js had to inline the entire handler to avoid HTTP mock complexity.
acceptance_criteria: lib/notesRepository.js exists with createNote() and listNotes()
pages/api/notes.js contains no SQL
api.test.js tests the repository directly, not via HTTP mock

tasks.title: Replace CommonJS/ESM mix
tasks.issue: notes.js uses `export default` (ESM) but imports db/init.js and lib/parser.js via `require()` (CommonJS). This mismatch caused the Jest test to have to inline the handler logic entirely.
tasks.fix: Convert db/init.js and lib/parser.js to ESM exports (`export function getDb()`, `export function parseNote()`), or set `"type": "module"` in package.json and update all require() calls. Pick one standard and apply it consistently.
acceptance_criteria: All files use the same module system (ESM or CJS)
api.test.js can import the handler directly without inlining

tasks.title: Parser: 'agreed to' / 'we decided' false-positive risk
tasks.issue: Lines 28-29: substring match on `lower.includes('we decided')` and `lower.includes('agreed to')` will misclassify lines like 'We decided not to do this' or 'The team agreed to disagree' — negations are invisible to the parser.
tasks.fix:
Restrict inline phrase matching to lines that start with the phrase, or require a colon to follow:
  /^we decided/.test(lower) || /^agreed to/.test(lower)
This reduces false positives without changing the happy path.
acceptance_criteria: 'We decided not to proceed' is NOT classified as a decision
'Decision: Proceed with plan A' still IS classified as a decision
Existing parser tests still pass

tasks.title: Add error boundary around JSON.parse in GET handler
tasks.issue: Lines 49-51: JSON.parse(row.decisions_json) etc. will throw if a row contains malformed JSON (e.g. from a manual DB edit or a future bug). This crashes the entire GET /api/notes response.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/notes does not 500 when one row has malformed JSON
The malformed row returns empty arrays for affected fields
